title: Entity
description: One searchable thing. Every entity of the site uses this shape, and the `kind` field selects the renderer. The pipeline writes these objects into the sharded entity JSON.

name.description: The display name. Search shows this text, and no key uses it.

aliases.description: Every extra search term of this entity. The list holds identifier segments, community shorthand, and curated extras. Search matches these as well as the name.

icon.description: The sprite key in the atlas coordinate map. A missing icon is a broken join between the wiki and the registry, so the build reports it.

blurb.description: The intro text of the wiki page, as plain text.

wikiUrl.description: The source wiki page. The license is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, so the user interface shows this link as a visible credit. Every entity carries one, because an entity that shows wiki text without a link to it breaks the license. The host is fixed too: the project reads minecraft.wiki and never Fandom, so the site keeps one scraper and one attribution obligation.

sourceTiers.description: The tier that produced each field of this entity. The key is the field name. Wrong data is traceable to its source through this map.

sections.description: The render blocks of this entity, in render order.

entityId.description: A namespaced identifier. Vanilla content uses the `minecraft` namespace. A collection page uses the `collection` namespace. A display name is never a key.

entityKind.description: The discriminator of the Entity model. It selects the renderer.

sourceTier.description: The tier that produced one field. A is vanilla game data from mcmeta. B is the Minecraft Wiki. C is a curated override. A later tier wins.

entityRef.title: EntityRef
entityRef.description: A cross-reference to another entity. A renderer never prints an entity name as plain text. It prints this object as a link that opens a new window.

name.description: The display name of the target, at the time of the build.

section.description: One render block. The `type` field selects the renderer. Phase 3 replaces the open payload of each member with real fields.

statBlock.title: StatBlock
statBlock.description: Named numbers of an entity. Health and damage of a mob are two examples. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

spawnInfo.title: SpawnInfo
spawnInfo.description: Where the entity spawns, and under which conditions. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

dropTable.title: DropTable
dropTable.description: What the entity drops, per looting level. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

recipeTree.title: RecipeTree
recipeTree.description: The obtain tree of an item. Brewing is a node of this tree. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

obtainList.title: ObtainList
obtainList.description: Every acquisition path that the wiki Obtaining section lists. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

breedingInfo.title: BreedingInfo
breedingInfo.description: The items that breed a mob, and the result. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

effectSources.title: EffectSources
effectSources.description: Every source of a status effect. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

advancementInfo.title: AdvancementInfo
advancementInfo.description: How the player earns an advancement, and the parent chain. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

tradeTable.title: TradeTable
tradeTable.description: Villager trades, grouped by profession and level. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

chestLoot.title: ChestLoot
chestLoot.description: The chest loot tables that hold the item. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

enchantInfo.title: EnchantInfo
enchantInfo.description: Levels, applicable items, costs, and the exclusive set. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

generationInfo.title: GenerationInfo
generationInfo.description: Where a block, a structure, or a biome generates. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.

linkList.title: LinkList
linkList.description: A plain list of links to other entities. The payload of this section arrives in Phase 3.
